subject: Sponsor activation & EB windows for Acme close
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2027-02-28T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Sponsor activation & EB windows for Acme close

Hi Aditya / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here is excited. Procurement asked that we lock down an explicit Mutual Action Plan and map which execs will attend an EB-level brief so we can clear internal approvals.

Quick context: Acme wants to complete evaluation and finalize procurement by the end of March. Our internal calendar is tight; we need an exec-level briefing (30–45m) after the technical eval to get final sign-off from the CFO and CTO.

Requested from Redwood:
- A one-page MAP we can share with stakeholders (deliverables and dates).
- Exec sponsor recommendations from your side and which Redwood exec(s) can join the EB meeting.
- Proposed dates for the EB briefing (we prefer the week of March 8–12).

I attached our internal draft MAP (Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx) for reference. Can you propose an updated MAP and confirm RBW exec availability?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15m sync if helpful.

Sara Liu
Senior PM, Acme Analytics
Sara.Liu@acme.com
(Attachment: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx, xlsx)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-28T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor activation & EB windows for Acme close

Sara — thanks for the clear ask. Appreciate the MAP stub; we will take that and produce a concise mutual action plan tied to specific evaluation milestones.

High level proposal (quick bullets):
- Technical eval (PoC/canary): March 8–10 — run standard perf/latency + cost-per-token baseline.
- Business evaluation: March 11 — executive briefing (EB) with 30–45m Q&A.
- Procurement & contract sign: March 25 target (aligned to your EoM ask).

Executive sponsor mapping (Redwood side):
- Primary exec sponsor: Marissa Cole (VP, GTM) — will own the EB conversation and commercial commitments.
- Secondary (technical) exec: Karthik Iyer (Head of Solutions) — will join for technical Q&A if needed.

Can Ben and Grace help turn the attached MAP into a version that aligns to the above dates and includes concrete acceptance criteria for the eval? Ben — can you own the eval plan doc and drop the updated MAP back to Sara by EOD Monday?

Proposed EB windows (PT):
- Thu, Mar 11: 09:00–10:00, 10:00–10:45, 14:00–14:45
- Fri, Mar 12: 08:30–09:15

Flagging Marissa here so she can approve the EB participation. If any of those windows are bad for your execs, tell us which times your CFO/CTO prefer and we’ll adjust.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
(Attachment referenced: will produce updated MAP)

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme.com, david.park@acme.com, helena.soto@acme.com
Date: 2027-03-01T09:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor activation & EB windows for Acme close

Aditya — thanks, that schedule is helpful. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Exec attendees: David Park (CFO) and Helena Soto (CTO) — both asked for a 30–45m briefing focused on commercial terms and production SLA / security posture.
- Preferred EB slot: Thu Mar 11, 10:00–10:45 PT (this works best for both execs).

Procurement side: procurement@acme.com asked for the MAP and a short eval acceptance checklist tied to the PoC success criteria. We’ll need the final MAP and the eval plan by Tuesday EOD (Mar 2) to route for approval.

Sara
Sara Liu
Senior PM, Acme Analytics
(Attachment: Acme internal MAP for reference)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-02T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor activation & EB windows for Acme close

Thanks Sara — looping in the MAP and a short eval plan. Attached: MAP_Acme_v1.1.xlsx and Eval_plan_Acme.pdf.

Action items (owner -> deliverable / due):
- Ben Carter -> Eval plan (canary checklist + perf targets) / Mar 2 EOD (done, attached).
- Grace O'Connor -> Exec briefing slide (one-pager, outcomes & ask) / Mar 9 EOD.
- Marissa Cole -> confirm EB attendance (Mar 11 10:00 PT) / Mar 3.

Quick notes on the eval: we recommend the canary run use your standard workload with synthetic spikes for 30 minutes to validate tail latency at 95th/99th. Acceptance criteria are in the Eval_plan.

(Attachments: MAP_Acme_v1.1.xlsx, Eval_plan_Acme.pdf)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-04T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor activation & EB windows for Acme close

Sara — thanks for confirming the slot. I’ll own the EB one-pager and coordinate logistics.

Confirming: Thu Mar 11, 10:00–10:45 PT is locked on our side. Attendees from Redwood: Marissa Cole (VP, GTM) + Karthik Iyer (Solutions) + myself (SE lead).

I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda:
1) 5m introductions
2) 15m business value + contract summary (Marissa)
3) 10m technical highlights & canary results (Karthik)
4) 10m Q&A / next steps

Can you confirm the dial-in preference (Zoom / Meet) and if procurement wants a separate breakout immediately after the EB to review contract redlines? Also dropping a link to the MAP we just published.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
(Attachment: none)

Perfect — March 11, 10:00–10:45 PT works. We prefer Zoom (company policy). Procurement is fine with a brief breakout immediately after the EB on the same Zoom link.
